blocks.text: A MOO is a text-based online virtual reality system to where multiple users (players) are connected at the same time.
Bulls and cows is a code-breaking mind or paper and pencil game for two or more players. The game is played in turns by two opponents who aim to decipher the other's secret code by trial and error.

images.alt: 4digits, an open source version of bulls and cows. This software uses "A" to denote "bulls" (digit in the correct position) and "B" to denote "cows" (digit in the wrong position).
